4840.title: Manual environment cleanup bypasses path ownership
4840.rootCauseOneLine: Explicit cleanup checks for a provider ID but not providerOwnsPath, so the checkout provider's no-op removal destroys an unmanaged attachment record.
4840.proposedFix: Require providerOwnsPath in the explicit cleanup guard; preserve automatic retirement and project-deletion behavior and add a route regression with the actual checkout provider.
4840.caveats: Server-route reproduction on Linux with real SQLite and the actual checkout plugin; no macOS enrollment, CLI/provider turn, git branch/process survival, or subsequent restoration flow was exercised.
